main_text.l: omissis, quæ nec causam probant, nec bonis commun-
icantibus inter se dignæ sunt, in rei ipsius disquisitione
hærebimus, & non omnia quæ Illyricus protulit,
esse mendacia demonstrabimus. Id illiberale factum
& nobis indignum foret, dare operam ut hic eodem
poculo à nobis biberet, quo Illyricum à se voluit
dictum Maronis semel respondeat, Parcius ista viris
tamen obiicienda memento, &c. Hominis causam non
agimus, nec infirmitates probamus; homo fuit: sed
veritatis Dei Συνεργός, & quidem constantes, nos

page.notes: Marginal text at the left edge is show-through from the reverse page and was omitted. The marginal Greek word beside "omnia" is printed as "πάντα" and is partly illegible in the scan; the Greek at "Συνεργός" is approximate. Printed page number "1" top right; the bottom mark "[ꝫ]" is a signature and was not certain.
